agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has high G=4.07 and massive fast bodies 0 and 2 that converge to 1.08 distance by step 5. Despite substep splitting (capped at 16 substeps per outer step, dt=0.025 -> effective ~1.5ms), the leapfrog integration error accumulates strongly during the close, high-acceleration encounter (potential deepens from -90 to -210). Momentum drifts: momentum_x changes from -155.15 at step 0 to -154.85 at step 5 and momentum_y from 24.84 to 25.08, angular momentum and energy also drift, with momentum change 0.385 exceeding allowed 0.194 at step 5. Reducing only dt to 0.005 (same steps, G, masses, positions) eliminates the violation, confirming coarse time resolution vs strong forces is the cause.
